name: Get blog posts in space
description: Get blog posts in space Returns all blog posts in a space. GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}/blogposts
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}/blogposts
Returns all blog posts in a space. The number of results is limited by the `limit` parameter and additional results (if available) will be available through the `next` URL present in the `Link` response header. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to access the Confluence site ('Can use' global permission) and view the space. Only blog posts that the user has permission to view will be returned.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the space for which blog posts should be returned.
Optional: sort (query) — Used to sort the result by a particular field.; status (query) — Filter the results to blog posts based on their status. By default, `current` is used.; title (query) — Filter the results to blog posts based on their title.; body-format (query) — The content format types to be returned in the `body` field of the response. If available, the representation will be available under a response field of the same name under the `body` field.; cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; limit (query) — Maximum number of blog posts per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.

name: Get custom content by type in space
description: Get custom content by type in space Returns all custom content for a given type within a given space. GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}/custom-content
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}/custom-content
Returns all custom content for a given type within a given space. The number of results is limited by the `limit` parameter and additional results (if available) will be available through the `next` URL present in the `Link` response header. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the custom content and the corresponding space.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the space for which custom content should be returned.; type (query) — The type of custom content being requested. See: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/custom-content/ for additional details on custom content.
Optional: cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; limit (query) — Maximum number of pages per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.; body-format (query) — The content format types to be returned in the `body` field of the response. If available, the representation will be available under a response field of the same name under the `body` field. Note: If the custom content body type is `storage`, the `storage` and `atlas_doc_format` body formats are able to be returned. If the custom content body type is `raw`, only the `raw` body format is able to be returned.

name: Get pages in space
description: Get pages in space Returns all pages in a space. GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}/pages
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}/pages

If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.

name: Get space by id
description: Get space by id Returns a specific space. GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}
Returns a specific space. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the space.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the space to be returned.
Optional: description-format (query) — The content format type to be returned in the `description` field of the response. If available, the representation will be available under a response field of the same name under the `description` field.; include-icon (query) — If the icon for the space should be fetched or not.; include-operations (query) — Includes operations associated with this space in the response, as defined in the `Operation` object. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-properties (query) — Includes space properties associated with this space in the response. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-permissions (query) — Includes space permissions associated with this space in the response. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-role-assignments (query) — Includes role assignments associated with this space in the response. This parameter is only accepted for EAP sites. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-labels (query) — Includes labels associated with this space in the response. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.

name: Get space role assignments
description: Get space role assignments Retrieves the space role assignments. GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}/role-assignments
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}/role-assignments
Retrieves the space role assignments. Available on tenants with [Role-Based Access Control](https://support.atlassian.com/confluence-cloud/docs/manage-user-roles/). **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the space.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the space for which to retrieve assignments.
Optional: role-id (query) — Filters the returned role assignments to the provided role ID.; role-type (query) — Filters the returned role assignments to the provided role type.; principal-id (query) — Filters the returned role assignments to the provided principal id. If specified, a principal-type must also be specified. Paired with a `principal-type` of `ACCESS_CLASS`, valid values include [`anonymous-users`, `jsm-project-admins`, `authenticated-users`, `all-licensed-users`, `all-product-admins`]; principal-type (query) — Filters the returned role assignments to the provided principal type. If specified, a principal-id must also be specified.; cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; limit (query) — Maximum number of space roles to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` response header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.

name: Get spaces
description: Get spaces Returns all spaces. GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces
Returns all spaces. The results will be sorted by id ascending. The number of results is limited by the `limit` parameter and additional results (if available) will be available through the `next` URL present in the `Link` response header. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to access the Confluence site ('Can use' global permission). Only spaces that the user has permission to view will be returned.
Optional: ids (query) — Filter the results to spaces based on their IDs. Multiple IDs can be specified as a comma-separated list.; keys (query) — Filter the results to spaces based on their keys. Multiple keys can be specified as a comma-separated list.; type (query) — Filter the results to spaces based on their type.; status (query) — Filter the results to spaces based on their status.; labels (query) — Filter the results to spaces based on their labels. Multiple labels can be specified as a comma-separated list.; favorited-by (query) — Filter the results to spaces favorited by the user with the specified account ID.; not-favorited-by (query) — Filter the results to spaces NOT favorited by the user with the specified account ID.; sort (query) — Used to sort the result by a particular field.; description-format (query) — The content format type to be returned in the `description` field of the response. If available, the representation will be available under a response field of the same name under the `description` field.; include-icon (query) — If the icon for the space should be fetched or not.; cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; limit (query) — Maximum number of spaces per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` response header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.

name: Set space role assignments
description: Set space role assignments Sets space role assignments as specified in the payload. POST /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}/role-assignments
context:
POST /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}/role-assignments
Sets space role assignments as specified in the payload. For each entry, if `roleId` is provided the principal is assigned to that role. If `roleId` is omitted, the role assignment for that principal is removed, if it exists. Available on tenants with [Role-Based Access Control](https://support.atlassian.com/confluence-cloud/docs/manage-user-roles/). **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to manage roles in the space.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the space for which to retrieve assignments.; body (body)
